title: lane r6 SE: delta join key undefined under in-lane renames
description: Lane round 6. Lens: SE (validator: SO). Owner: SO session. Defect: the baseline-vs-HEAD comparison joins by an undefined test identity while renames are in-lane — a renamed-and-regressed test presents as new-at-HEAD plus vanished-at-baseline and escapes the delta. Citations verified: contract:64, :81. Proposed: resolved-candidate (a fix commit does not rename tests — renames are mechanical passes carried separately; the join key is the runner-reported test path, stable by that rule).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: a fix commit does not rename tests (renames are mechanical passes carried separately); the delta join key is the runner-reported test path, stable by that rule. Revision: gate bullet.
